version.reviewNotes: kmd is a local-first Markdown editor. No account or special setup is required. Launch the app, create or open a Markdown file, then use Editor, Preview, and Outline. The share extension accepts text shared from other apps. This version does not include cloud sync, subscriptions, advertising, analytics, or user-generated public content.

en-US.subtitle: Local-first Markdown notes
en-US.description:
Write Markdown without giving up speed, ownership, or focus. kmd is a lightweight local-first editor for iPhone and iPad.

• Edit plain Markdown files with a fast CodeMirror-based editor
• Preview headings, paragraphs, lists, quotes, code, and inline formatting
• Navigate a live document outline with word counts and section ratios
• Create a blank note immediately or open files from the Files app
• Share text into the local inbox and keep working offline
• Restore your current draft automatically

Your documents remain ordinary Markdown files. kmd does not require an account and does not include advertising or analytics.
en-US.promotionalText: Fast, local-first Markdown editing with live preview and a structural outline.

zh-Hans.subtitle: 本地优先的 Markdown 笔记
zh-Hans.description:
使用 kmd 在 iPhone 和 iPad 上快速编辑 Markdown，同时保留文件所有权与专注体验。

• 使用高性能编辑器处理纯 Markdown 文件
• 实时预览标题、段落、列表、引用、代码与行内格式
• 在文档大纲中查看章节、字数和内容占比
• 启动后立即新建空白笔记，或从“文件”打开文档
• 将其他 App 的文本分享到本地收件箱
• 自动恢复当前草稿，完整支持离线使用

文档始终保持为普通 Markdown 文件。kmd 无需账户，不含广告或分析追踪。
